lines.zh: 我身上的骨板互相磨着，咔咔响。
lines.en: My bone plates grind against each other.

lines.zh: 我冲得不快，可停不下来。
lines.en: I don't charge fast, but I can't stop.

lines.zh: 我低着头，只看前面几格。
lines.en: Head down, I see only a few blocks ahead.

lines.zh: 下界的地面，被我的脚凿出坑。
lines.en: My feet gouge the nether's ground.

lines.zh: 我一路撞过去，石头都翻起来。
lines.en: I plow through and the stone turns over.
Short legs, but heavy strides.
Step by step. I never stop.
Mouth open, ready to bite.

lines.zh: 骨板下的肉，保护得很好。
lines.en: The flesh under my plates is well protected.

lines.zh: 我沿着岩浆边走，找活物。
lines.en: I walk the lava's edge, hunting the living.
One roar, then I charge on.

lines.zh: 我的影子在红雾里，很黑。
lines.en: My shadow in the red haze is very black.
I stand still as the plates rise and fall.
Heat rises from my mouth.
I'm listening. The nether is loud.
I claw at the ground.

lines.zh: 这一身骨板，是后来长的。
lines.en: These plates grew on me later.

lines.zh: 我歪了歪头，脖子咯咯响。
lines.en: I tilt my head; my neck grinds.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛很小，藏在骨缝里。
lines.en: My eyes are small, tucked in the seams.

lines.zh: 岩浆的热气，让我很舒服。
lines.en: The heat off the lava suits me.
I wait for something close enough.

lines.zh: 闭上眼，鼻子里还是火药味。
lines.en: Eyes shut, and my nose still smells gunpowder.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，骨板都竖起来。
lines.en: I raise my head and the plates bristle.

lines.zh: 你看起来很软，我喜欢软的。
lines.en: You look soft. I like soft.
I fix on you and my mouth opens slowly.
This close, you should be backing away.
I smell sweat on you.
I don't speak. I only roar.

lines.zh: 你的手在抖，很轻的声音。
lines.en: Your hands shake. A very small sound.

lines.zh: 我往旁边挪了半步，正对你。
lines.en: I shift half a step to face you square.
You won't break through these plates.

lines.zh: 我往前倾，重心压在前腿。
lines.en: I lean forward, weight on my forelimbs.
A plate took it, but it still hurts.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，骨板响了一声。
lines.en: I step back and a plate clanks.
That one found a seam.
I roar. Not a threat.

lines.zh: 我的骨板被打得往里凹。
lines.en: My bone plates are dented inward.
Teeth clenched, my mouth still open.
I lower my head and turn my plates out.

lines.zh: 这一击进去，我喘了半口。
lines.en: That blow sank in; I get half a breath.
All four legs shake, but none buckle.
Blood runs into my seams. Hot.
Meat, and not yet touched by fire.
Mouth open, I wait for you to set it down.
Not enough. More.
I bite down, your hand included.
Two chews and it's down.
Too hard. I can't bite it.
I'm very close. Don't move.
I lick my lips. Slowly.
I charge with my mouth wide open.
I grunt and back off.

lines.zh: 你撞在骨板上，声音很闷。
lines.en: You strike the plates with a dull sound.
I don't move. You're the one who bounced.
I push forward and shove you aside.

lines.zh: 这一下，我连眼睛都没眨。
lines.en: I didn't even blink at that.

lines.zh: 我转不过来，你绕过去吧。
lines.en: I can't turn. Go around me.
My plates clash loudly.

lines.zh: 你身上留下了我的味道。
lines.en: You carry my smell now.

lines.zh: 我站稳了，脚下一片碎石。
lines.en: I steady myself on a patch of rubble.
Don't stand by my mouth.

lines.zh: 这一撞，把岩浆都溅起来了。
lines.en: That splashed the lava up.

lines.zh: 我吼了一声，骨板都张开了。
lines.en: I roar and the plates flare open.
An answer comes back, muffled.

lines.zh: 两只对撞了一下，地上的石头都碎了。
lines.en: Two of us butt; the stone shatters.

lines.zh: 它身上的骨板比我的厚。
lines.en: Its plates are thicker than mine.

lines.zh: 我用鼻子碰了碰它的角。
lines.en: I touch my snout to its horn.

lines.zh: 这一片下界，够我们两个。
lines.en: This stretch of nether suits us both.

lines.zh: 我们并排站在熔岩边上。
lines.en: We stand side by side at the lava's edge.

lines.zh: 火光照着我的骨板，很亮。
lines.en: Firelight glints on my plates.

lines.zh: 我们互相看了看，就各自走了。
lines.en: We look at each other, then part.

lines.zh: 这种事，下界里天天都有。
lines.en: This happens in the nether every day.
I bite down and crunch it.
Hard thing. Nearly broke a tooth.
I grind it into a crack in the stone.

lines.zh: 我吞下去了，什么感觉都没有。
lines.en: Swallowed. Felt nothing.
Not food. I fling it aside.

lines.zh: 我咬碎了，咽下去还是烫。
lines.en: I crunch it, and it's still hot going down.
I hold it and turn around.

lines.zh: 我在骨缝里夹了一下，没夹住。
lines.en: I try to wedge it between my plates. No luck.
The living would want this.

lines.zh: 我踩了一脚，把它压碎了。
lines.en: I step on it and crush it.

lines.zh: 你一动，我的四蹄就刨地。
lines.en: The moment you move, my four hooves paw the ground.

lines.zh: 骨板全竖起来，我压低头。
lines.en: Plates bristle; I lower my head.

lines.zh: 骨板一压，我朝你直线撞。
lines.en: Bone plates down, I charge straight at you.
That roar was for you.

lines.zh: 地面被我踩出两条深沟。
lines.en: Two deep furrows open under my feet.

lines.zh: 我不停下，停下就撞不动了。
lines.en: I won't stop; stopping kills the charge.
You're between me and the lava.

lines.zh: 我张着嘴，牙上全是热气。
lines.en: Mouth open, teeth steaming.
Perfect distance to charge.

lines.zh: 你每退一步，我多踩碎一块石头。
lines.en: Every step you back, I crush another stone.
These plates will hurt when they land.
Charge first. Bite after.
My eyes are on your waist.
I've built up the force for this.
I keep straight. Never swerving.
You go left; I turn slowly after.

lines.zh: 我喘得很响，热气往外喷。
lines.en: My breathing's loud, heat spraying out.

lines.zh: 你一退，地上就留一串脚印。
lines.en: You retreat and leave a line of prints.
I don't fear pain. I fear you getting far.

lines.zh: 骨板挡着，我还能再挨几下。
lines.en: The plates will take a few more hits.

lines.zh: 这一片碎石，都是我踩的。
lines.en: This rubble is all from my feet.

lines.zh: 我张嘴的时候，你就该跑。
lines.en: When I open my mouth, you should run.
Further back and you're on the rock wall.
I'm speeding up; the ground shakes.
Just a few blocks. Quick.
When I lower my head, I'm about to hit.

lines.zh: 你绕你的，我只会走直线。
lines.en: You can circle; I only go straight.

lines.zh: 我的骨板张开了又合上。
lines.en: My bone plates flare and shut again.
This will put you three steps back.
One last look at you.
The plates crash in with a heavy sound.
I bite and my teeth sink in.
That shoved you to the wall.
I swing my head and throw you up.
I don't stop; I keep going after impact.
You've got a few new holes now.
I roar, satisfied.

lines.zh: 这一下不重，我还能再撞。
lines.en: Light. I can hit again.

lines.zh: 我自己撞到墙上，晕了一下。
lines.en: I crash into a wall and daze myself.

lines.zh: 我踩过去，碎石都飞起来。
lines.en: I trample through and debris flies.
My mouth closes; the teeth still click.

lines.zh: 这一下，是我给你留的印记。
lines.en: That's my mark on you.
I back off for a second run.

lines.zh: 你挡得住，但挡不了几下。
lines.en: You can block. Not many times.

lines.zh: 这一下撞得我牙都松了。
lines.en: That impact loosened a tooth.
I shake my head and lunge again.

lines.zh: 骨板先从地里翻出来，然后是我。
lines.en: The plates break the ground first, then me.

lines.zh: 我落地时，石头塌了一块。
lines.en: I land and a patch of stone collapses.

lines.zh: 下界的空气，一下子热了。
lines.en: The nether air goes hot at once.

lines.zh: 我张嘴吼了一声，很远都听见。
lines.en: I open up and roar; it carries far.
These plates are thicker than last time.
I stand tall, unable to see overhead.

lines.zh: 我先闻了闻，附近有活物。
lines.en: I sniff. Something living nearby.

lines.zh: 脚下的碎石，被我踩得更碎。
lines.en: The rubble under me crunches finer.
I turn slowly to get my bearings.
The lava's not far. Good.
One move and all the plates rattle.
I'm sturdier than last time.

lines.zh: 火把骨板烧红了，烫到肉。
lines.en: Fire heats the plates red and burns my flesh.

lines.zh: 我砸到地上，骨板裂了一条。
lines.en: I crash down and a plate splits.

lines.zh: 水灌进嘴里，我从鼻子里喷出来。
lines.en: Water pours in and sprays out my nose.
The blast flips me right over.

lines.zh: 有东西卡在骨缝里，很碍事。
lines.en: Something's stuck in my seams. Very annoying.

lines.zh: 光罩着我，我的腿沉得抬不动。
lines.en: Light covers me and my legs won't lift.
Hungry enough that my plates feel loose.

lines.zh: 雷劈在骨板上，火花四射。
lines.en: Lightning hits my plates and sparks fly.
No ground below. I'm falling.
